rv.q: Musical adaptation of the Cliff Richard film beams simple sunshine

It’s an immensely good-humoured and infectious show, with the audience joining in on the final “Do You Wanna Dance” so far as space allows, and crams in many other Cliff Richard favourites, stealing “The Young Ones” from his earlier film.

Lacking in stakes but not taking itself seriously enough for that to matter, Summer Holiday is a blissful adventure with a charming ensemble cast whose soaring vocals and strong musicianship are on strong display.
The pervading feeling of the production is infectious fun. This show is all about the joy of the music and every song is a delight.
